acceptanceCriteria: A /2 ledger whose recorded workers are all provably gone (pid absent, or leader/process identity mismatch, using the same liveness check the /2 build used to reap) migrates to /3, reaping those workers, with the reap recorded.
A /2 ledger with any worker that is live or whose liveness cannot be proven is still refused, and the refusal names the old build and the exact clearing command.
Maintained tests cover all-dead, one-live and unprovable cases; the dispatch spec records the requirement.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#668, filed 2026-10-07. Upgrading 0b45b05 -> 0b5096c (dispatch state /2 -> /3, #661) left the program down: the new build refuses with UNSUPPORTED_VERSION '/workers: a taskman-dispatch-state/2 ledger that records workers must be drained by the build that wrote it' even when every recorded worker's pid is gone (the dispatcher got SIGTERM before its last tick reaped one ended worker). Recovery needed the old binary run with --once and launches held. Code: internal/tasks/dispatch/ledger.go. Versions: corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360); corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; reporter on main-0b5096c, macOS arm64.
